text:
```yaml
name: Publish Studio to NPM

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'studio-v*'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: 'Version to publish (e.g., 1.0.0)'
        required: true
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: read
  id-token: write

jobs:
  publish-studio:
    name: Publish Studio Package
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: packages/studio

    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: latest

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: bun install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Build Studio Package
        run: bun run build

      - name: Determine Version
        id: version
        run: |
          if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" == "workflow_dispatch" ]; then
            VERSION="${{ github.event.inputs.version }}"
          else
            # Extract version from tag studio-v1.2.3 -> 1.2.3
            VERSION=$(echo "${{ github.ref_name }}" | sed 's/^studio-v//')
          fi
          echo "version=$VERSION" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "Publishing version: $VERSION"

      - name: Configure NPM Auth
        run: |
          echo "//registry.npmjs.org/:_authToken=${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}" > .npmrc

      - name: Publish to NPM
        run: |
          # Update package.json version if needed, or rely on pre-built version
          # Assuming the version is already set in package.json by the release process
          # or we can set it here if it's a manual dispatch without tag update
          if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" == "workflow_dispatch" ]; then
            bun pkg set version="${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}"
          fi
          
          npm publish --access public
        env:
          NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
```
